Maya (CSM): Quick weekly account health snapshot — focusing on p95/p99 by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming. Posting top-line numbers + flags.

Maya (CSM): ```
Route: /chat-stream  Model: redwood-13b-streaming  p95: 420ms  p99: 1.9s  errors: 0.6%  spend: +18% w/w
Route: /chat-sync    Model: redwood-13b          p95: 340ms  p99: 1.1s  errors: 0.3%  spend: +4% w/w
Route: /embed        Model: embed-2             p95: 45ms   p99: 120ms  errors: 0.05% spend: +1% w/w
Notes: streaming p99 up mostly on long-context tails; spend bump correlates with #streamed tokens.
```

Leo (SRE): seeing the p99 spike in pods serving streaming. At ~18:22 we had queue depth spike on pod-gpu-7, CPU fine but GPU queueing. I captured logs:

Leo (SRE): ```
[18:22:14] WARN batcher: queue_wait 1.3s, batch_size=18
[18:22:15] WARN kv-cache: cache_miss_ratio=0.47
[18:22:16] ERROR model-worker: outlier_latency=1900ms
```

Dena (CS): tagging — Acme onboarding uses /chat-stream heavily. They reported intermittent slowness yesterday, but didn't escalate. I'll check their session IDs and reach out if it's affecting rollout.

Aj (DevEx): Suggestion: enable route-level fallback policy to non-streaming redwood-13b for requests that exceed 2s in queue, and add a small canary on a subset of users. Also recommend reducing default stream chunk size to 512 tokens temporarily.

ops-bot: :warning: Alert: cost-anomaly detected — streaming token count +22% last 48h, top contributors: /chat-stream (64%), background-batch (18%).

Maya (CSM): Action items:
- Leo to investigate queueing and propose autoscale tweak or batch-size cap by EOD (owner: Leo)
- Aj to prepare fallback config PR and a 1-hour canary (owner: Aj)
- Dena to ping Acme and surface any user impact in renewal thread (owner: Dena)
- Ops to throttle background-batch or adjust routing if cost stays high (owner: ops-bot)

Maya (CSM): Can everyone ack and add ETA? :thumbsup:

Leo (SRE): Ack — will post a runbook update and ETA ~ 3h.
Aj (DevEx): Ack — targeting canary in 5h, PR in 2h.
Dena (CS): Ack — reaching out to Acme now, will update within 4h.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Automated mitigation policy queued.

Maya (CSM): Thanks — we'll reconvene in the weekday sync if anything critical changes. End thread.
